# Bundled bible-fetch

Original author: Erik J. Sturcke. Additional contributions by Ben Tsai and others.

Source: https://github.com/covode/bible-fetch
Revision: `ba8c6064746d77a305c97d5fe7305b1c2b358145`

`bible` is an unmodified copy from this revision. Its code matches the original
backend used to build Bible Search; its portable upstream shebang is retained.
The original MIT-style copyright and license are reproduced in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The installer provides a separate virtual environment with Beautiful Soup,
Requests, and Unidecode. Citation formatting is implemented in Bible Search,
not in this scraper.
